additive provider exposure, builder fail-closed gates, regression
independent reconstruction and reperformance on exact frozen target

freeze_order: materialize final 57-row F05 input bytes without scores
materialize policy, source-field, CA, code, and test artifacts
commit one exact pre-score D0 target and bind commit/tree/component/input hashes
obtain CTLV L1, MODV L1, ENGV L1, and IVA L2 independent receipts
if any bounded defect exists, correct once, freeze D1, and revalidate the affected target without PASS transfer
obtain independent post-score IVA readback of the actual output bytes
positive_cases: P01 ordinary non-CA 21/61 observations produce exactly 20/60 ChangesRatio intervals
P02 GST 2024-06-26 official KRX base-price change and 2024-07-24 exact Stocks boundary
P03 Exicon 2024-06-03 official KRX base-price change and 2024-07-31 Volume/Stocks boundary
P04 exact daily Volume/Stocks and recent20/prior20 acceleration arithmetic
P06 unchanged robust percentile, 0.50/0.30/0.20 recognition velocity, and saturation

negative_cases: N01 reject raw-close return at a CA boundary
N02 reject wrong issuer, event date, official source reference, or physical return field
N03 reject any economic observation later than 2024-08-09
N04 reject 56/57 and every silent benchmark denominator shrink
N05 reject missing, zero, nonfinite, boolean, or nonintegral Volume/Stocks
N06 reject duplicate code/date, missing or misaligned sessions, cutoff mismatch, and off-by-one intervals
N07 reject cash-dividend or adjusted-close total-return substitution; legacy scorer keys must be exact aliases only
N08 reject inferred adjustment factors and heuristic-as-CA truth
N09 reject F05 weight, features_v1, scorer_v1, narrow-patch, or config drift
N10 reject missing/wrong physical fields and percent/fraction scaling confusion while retaining old-provider compatibility
N11 reject canonical/legacy alias value or lineage mismatch
N12 reject scoring without exact-target independent PASS receipts or with dirty/preexisting outputs
N13 reject output counts/ranks or claims outside the provisional ceiling
